mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending confidence, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE has exceeded 5.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakness in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST and RSAFS both declining) fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of instances, as measured by a Rank IC below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annually), a rise in the federal funds rate leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to increased real interest rates.
failure_condition: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), a rise in FEDFUNDS does not lead to negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, as measured by a Rank IC below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months signals strengthening economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO has increased for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000 thousand units for two consecutive months, it indicates a contraction in the housing market that reduces consumer wealth and confidence, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST has been below 1000 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling) fails to predict positive returns in more than 40% of instances, as measured by a Rank IC below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0), a rise in the federal funds rate leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced economic activity and higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: In declining industrial production regimes (INDPRO < 95.0), a rise in FEDFUNDS does not lead to negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, as measured by a Rank IC below 0.03.
